_readme: Related reading shown at the end of every article and guide ('You Can Also Read'). 2 to 4 genuinely relevant items per page, never filler: a page with few natural neighbours simply shows fewer, and an entry is swapped when a better article is written. 'titles' are the link texts (taken from each page's own title). Applied by scripts/content/related.py (and by layout.apply when a generated page is rebuilt), checked by scripts/content/verify_related.py, which also lists pages with one or no inbound link as a gap list of topics worth writing. A new article or guide must get an entry here.
